Vendor profile

Gstarsoft

Pioneer of independently developed CAD platform in China — 30+ years building 2D/3D DWG CAD and verticals across AEC, mechanical, electrical, mapping, and BIM.

By Gstarcademy Editorial Team Reviewed by Gstarsoft Co., Ltd Last reviewed 2026-06-23 Editorial process

Company Overview

Gstarsoft Co., Ltd. (also known as Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese CAD software company headquartered in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province. Founded in 1992, Gstarsoft develops GstarCAD — a DWG-compatible 2D/3D CAD platform — along with vertical applications including GstarCAD Mechanical, GstarCAD Architecture, and GstarBIM.

GstarCAD is positioned as a professional-grade alternative to AutoCAD, emphasizing DWG compatibility, fast performance, and competitive licensing costs. The company serves customers in over 50 countries with particular strength in the Asia-Pacific market, Latin America, and Eastern Europe. Gstarsoft also provides GRX API compatibility for organizations migrating custom AutoCAD-based applications.

Product Portfolio

  • GstarCAD: Flagship DWG-native 2D/3D drafting platform with GRX/LISP/VBA API support, .NET integration, and enterprise deployment tools.
  • GstarCAD Mechanical: Mechanical design add-on with standards-based part libraries, BOM generation, and tolerance annotation.
  • GstarCAD Architecture: Architectural design module with wall, door, window, and staircase tools compliant with regional building standards.
  • GstarBIM: BIM-oriented platform for architects and interior designers combining 3D modeling with documentation workflows.

Market Position & Strategy

Gstarsoft Co., Ltd is a Chinese CAD software company that develops GstarCAD, one of the leading DWG-compatible alternatives to AutoCAD in the Asia-Pacific market. Founded in 1992, the company has built a significant user base in China, Southeast Asia, and expanding into European and Latin American markets.

GstarCAD's value proposition centers on full DWG compatibility at a substantially lower price point than AutoCAD, with perpetual licensing still available alongside subscription options. This pricing model appeals to firms and markets where Autodesk's subscription-only pricing creates budget constraints, particularly for organizations with large seat counts.

Gstarsoft's strategy includes both the core GstarCAD desktop product and vertical solutions (GstarCAD Mechanical, GstarCAD Architecture) that add discipline-specific tools on top of the general-purpose platform. The company also invests in mobile and cloud viewing capabilities through its collaboration platform.

Technology Platform

GstarCAD's DWG engine provides native read/write support for DWG files up to the current format version. The drawing engine is optimized for large file handling, with proprietary memory management that allows GstarCAD to open and edit complex drawings that may strain competing products. The 2D drafting performance benchmarks favorably against AutoCAD for common operations like zoom, pan, and entity selection in drawings with hundreds of thousands of entities.

The customization platform supports LISP (compatible with AutoCAD LISP routines), GRX (a C++ API analogous to AutoCAD's ARX), and .NET, allowing firms with existing AutoCAD customization investments to migrate their tools with relatively moderate porting effort. This API compatibility is a deliberate strategy to lower the switching cost barrier for AutoCAD users.

GstarCAD's collaborative features include DWG Compare, cloud-based drawing review, and PDF underlay management. The mobile companion app enables on-site drawing viewing and markup on tablets and phones without requiring a full desktop installation.
